Theorem GeometryStudentStep : (A: Point) -> (B: Point) -> (C: Point) -> (D: Point) -> (nd0: A ≠ B) -> (nd1: A ≠ C) -> (nd2: A ≠ D) -> (nd3: B ≠ C) -> (nd4: B ≠ D) -> (nd5: C ≠ D) -> (nt0: Not (Exists Line (fun L => OnLine A L /\ OnLine B L /\ OnLine C L))) -> (h2: (Between B D C) /\ (Length B D = Length D C)) -> (Length B D = Length D C)
Proof.
intro A.
intro B.
intro C.
intro D.
intro nd0.
intro nd1.
intro nd2.
intro nd3.
intro nd4.
intro nd5.
intro nt0.
intro h2.
destruct_ands h2 midpoint_inside midpoint_lengths.
exact (Eq.elim Measure (Length D C) (fun v => (Length B D) = v) ((Eq.elim Measure (Length B D) (fun v => (Length B D) = v) ((Eq.intro Measure (Length B D))) (Length D C) (midpoint_lengths))) (Length D C) ((Eq.intro Measure (Length D C)))).
Qed.
